title: The Oblist Announces Expansion of Curated Design Platform with Focus on Sustainability and Emerging Talent | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
A Premier Destination for Timeless Art and Design Now Shipping to Over 80 Countries
Paris, France, March 19, 2025 -- The Oblist, an innovative design platform co-founded by creative visionary Leia Sfez and her entrepreneurial husband Gary, is proud to announce its continued growth as a premier destination for curated, high-quality art, furniture, and objects. With a focus on timeless design and sustainability, The Oblist connects discerning collectors with emerging global talent, offering an exclusive selection of one-of-a-kind pieces that transcend trends.
Since its inception, The Oblist has become known for its commitment to exceptional craftsmanship and unique, carefully curated collections. The platform spans over 350 brands and artists, offering contemporary and vintage pieces that reflect the artistry, history, and cultures behind them. From the striking works of emerging designers like Natalia Criado and Studio HAOS to the sculptural elegance of Wendy Andreu and the enduring beauty of Goossens, The Oblist curates pieces that elevate spaces and tell stories.
At the heart of The Oblist’s offering is its focus on conscious and sustainable design. The majority of the platform’s items are made-to-order, supporting waste-reducing production values. This commitment not only helps to reduce environmental impact but also champions the idea of investing in objects that will be cherished and passed down for generations. By focusing on longevity and intentional consumption, The Oblist offers clients more than just furniture and art—it offers pieces that are built to last.
“Our vision has always been to create a platform where people can discover rare and exceptional works that truly reflect their individuality,” says Leia Sfez, Co-Founder of The Oblist. “We are excited to continue offering our clients not only incredible design but also an experience that is grounded in sustainability and meaningful consumption.”
The platform continues to build a community of artists, designers, and collectors who share a deep appreciation for creativity and craftsmanship. With international shipping to over 80 countries, The Oblist is broadening its reach, allowing design lovers worldwide to explore and purchase pieces that have been carefully sourced for their beauty, originality, and sustainability.
"We believe that design should have a lasting impact, both on the people who experience it and the environment," says Gary Sfez, Co-Founder of The Oblist . "Our platform is about making connections—between artists and their audiences, and between individuals and the objects that help them express their unique style."
The Oblist’s growth represents more than just an expansion of its offerings; it is a reflection of the growing global demand for sustainable design and the desire to support emerging artists and designers. The platform invites all those who value artistry, craftsmanship, and timeless design to discover pieces that will inspire, elevate, and endure.
